description: India's tech hub and 'Garden City', known for its pleasant climate, craft beer, vibrant nightlife, colonial buildings, and lakes.

places.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden (250-year-old Garden)
places.description: 240-acre botanical garden established by Hyder Ali in 1760. Features a 3,000+ tree collection, a historic glasshouse (replica of London's Crystal Palace), and India's finest tropical plant collection.

places.name: Bangalore Palace (Tudor-Gothic Royal Palace)
places.description: Built in 1878, this Tudor-Gothic palace is modelled on Windsor Castle. The royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty features fortified towers, battlements, and lush grounds spanning 454 acres.

places.name: Cubbon Park (Heritage Urban Forest)
places.description: 340-acre heritage urban park established in 1870 by Commissioner Richard Sankey. Contains neo-Gothic Attara Kacheri (High Court building), a band stand, and over 6,000 trees.

places.name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore (Grand Sri Radha Krishna Temple)
places.address: Hare Krishna Hill, Chord Road, Rajajinagar, Bangalore 560010
places.description: One of ISKCON's grandest temples worldwide, spread across a 7-storey complex with stunning architecture. Hosts 25,000+ visitors daily and is the largest Krishna temple in the world.

places.name: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms) — Legendary 1924 Breakfast
places.description: India's most famous South Indian restaurant, established in 1924. The legendary MTR masala dosa, rava idli (invented here), and filter coffee. Queue for 45 min — it's worth every second.

places.name: Vidhan Soudha (Iconic Legislative Building)
places.address: Dr. Ambedkar Veedhi, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bangalore 560001
places.description: Built in 1956 in Neo-Dravidian style, this granite legislative building is one of India's most beautiful government structures. Spectacular when illuminated on Sunday evenings.

places.name: Church Street Social (Iconic Bangalore Cafe & Bar)
places.description: Bangalore's most beloved hangout spot on iconic Church Street. Industrial-chic decor, craft cocktails, all-day food menu, and live events. The defining café of Bengaluru's new era.
